step1_analysis.description: A fully differential operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) with an NMOS input pair and PMOS active loads. It serves as a core amplification block, likely used to create virtual-ground nodes within the switched-current memory cells or filter described in the paper to minimize charge injection.

paper_reference.title: Switched-Current Circuits in Digital CMOS Technology With Low Charge-Injection Errors

dc_gain.description: Differential DC gain of the OTA

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported for the OTA (59 dB refers to THD)

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail current Itail ~= 311uA. gm = 2*(Itail/2)/Vov ~= 939uS. Rout = ro_n || ro_p ~= 32kOhm. Gain = gm*Rout ~= 30 V/V = 29.5 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical SKY130 parameters for L=0.5um devices with ~150uA branch current.

paper_reported.value: 10 MHz clock, 1 MHz cutoff for the overall filter

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm / (2*pi*CL). With gm=939uS and CL=1pF, UGBW = 149 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load capacitance. A 1pF load gives ~150MHz, which is more than sufficient for a 10MHz clock.

phase_margin.description: Phase Margin to ensure stability in closed-loop operation

sky130_expected.calculation: Single stage OTA with dominant pole at output. Phase shift approaches -90 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: As a single-stage OTA, it is inherently stable with a high phase margin, limited only by non-dominant poles.

power.description: Total DC power consumption of the OTA

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated from the tail current source bias (0.9V) and W/L (5/0.5).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, differential AC gain, UGBW, phase margin, and transient response of the fully differential OTA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Fully Differential OTA Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xms3=5u L_xms3=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xms4=5u L_xms4=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVCM_CTRL VCM_CTRL 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9

* Common-mode and Differential-mode inputs
VCM IN_CM 0 0.9
VDM IN_DM 0 DC 0 AC 1 SIN(0 0.1 1MEG 0 0)
E1 IN_PLUS IN_CM IN_DM 0 0.5
E2 IN_MINUS IN_CM IN_DM 0 -0.5

* DUT
XMS3 OUT_MINUS VCM_CTRL VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xms3} w={W_xms3}
XM2 OUT_PLUS IN_MINUS N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUT_MINUS IN_PLUS N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XMS4 OUT_PLUS VCM_CTRL VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xms4} w={W_xms4}

* Load Capacitance
CL1 OUT_PLUS 0 1p
CL2 OUT_MINUS 0 1p

.control
  * DC Operating Point for Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis for Gain, UGBW, and Phase Margin
  ac dec 100 1 1G
  let vout_diff = v(OUT_PLUS) - v(OUT_MINUS)
  let gain_db = 20*log10(mag(vout_diff))
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(vout_diff)
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_at_ugbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
  let pm = 180 + phase_at_ugbw
  print pm

  * Transient Analysis for Output Swing
  tran 1n 2u
  meas tran vout_max max v(OUT_PLUS)
  meas tran vout_min min v(OUT_PLUS)
  
  quit
.endc
.end
